info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Fooddelivery Deliveries Refunds-v5-spec
info.description: The Food Delivery Refunds API provides a mechanism for retrieving information about refund requests associated with food delivery services. This endpoint allows users to access a list of refunds, helping restaurants and service providers manage financial adjustments efficiently. Typical consumers include customer support teams and finance departments looking to track and analyze refund activities. With this API, businesses can improve their refund management processes and enhance customer satisfaction through better service handling.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch information about refunds related to deliveries. It provides comprehensive details about the refund status, amount, and related delivery items, enabling efficient tracking and management of returns.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to initiate a refund for deliveries. It should contain all necessary details regarding the refund request.

201.description: The refund request was successfully processed, and the resource has been created.

ListFooddeliveryDeliveriesRefundsRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation related to deliveries and refunds.

ListFooddeliveryDeliveriesRefundsRespons.title: Refund Operation Response

status.description: Indicates whether the refund operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: The reference number associated with the refund operation.

resultId.description: The unique identifier for the result of the refund operation.

state.description: The current state of the refund process.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the refund operation, measured in milliseconds.

message.description: A descriptive message related to the refund operation.

audit.description: Information regarding the audit of the refund operation.

ListFooddeliveryDeliveriesRefundsRespons.description: The response schema for a successful refund operation in the delivery system.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: The username of the person or system that created the refund request.

createdAt.description: The date and time when the refund request was created.

automated.description: Flag indicating whether the refund request was processed automatically.

AuditInfo.description: Contains audit details for the refund operation.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the time, in milliseconds, that the server took to process the request. A lower value denotes a quicker processing time.
